title: International Flights Resume to Iran
text:
International Flights Resume to Iran"

"TEHRAN - Oct 8,  The first international flight after a 40-day suspension landed at Imam Khomeini International Airport at 6:50 a.m. local time  today."

"The flight, operated by Iraqi Airways, had taken off from Najaf Airport in Iraq. After an official reception, it will depart for Najaf on its return leg.
